questions.prompt: For the lesson “Field Selection and Response Shaping”, which check provides the strongest practical evidence?
options: Run one happy-path call and skip invalid, denied, and failure scenarios.
Test against production records so the exercise cannot be repeated safely.

questions.answer_key: Test maximum page size, stable order, and continuation behavior across boundaries.
questions.explanation: A useful check is repeatable, tied to an observable contract, and includes an important negative or boundary scenario.

questions.prompt: Which review warning is most relevant to “Field Selection and Response Shaping”?
